race.comment: TRIFECTA RUBY (14) surprised at the big odds first up with a decisive victory over 1200m at Bathurst in BM58 grade. Ready for this trip in a fairly open contest. I'M SCARLETT (12) holding her form after she closed quickly to run second over 1400m at this track. Has the ability to mix it with them. OZZY THE EQUALISER (5) was going okay prior to drawing out with a battling ninth over 1300m at Corowa. Emily Waters has never been out of the frame when aboard and is among the leading chances. MORE CASH (4) caught the eye on resumption with a game fourth over 1200m at Tamworth in C2 class. Can go on with it today. SUNROE (7) comes back in trip and kept fresh for this. Gets his chance from the barrier.
